entries.title: Cut LLM turns in MCP interactions by 75%+
entries.summary: Tura reduces the number of LLM calls needed for Model Context Protocol interactions by over three-quarters, dramatically cutting latency and costs for AI agent development. This optimization directly impacts performance for developers building production AI systems.

entries.title: The whole of PyTorch on one page
entries.summary: A comprehensive visual guide mapping PyTorch's entire ecosystem on a single page, making it easier for developers to understand relationships between libraries and find relevant tools for their ML projects.

entries.title: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash: Better, faster, at a quarter of the cost
entries.summary: Microsoft's latest code model delivers improved performance with significantly reduced inference costs and latency, making it practical for developers to integrate advanced code generation into production applications.

entries.title: Search over the Visual World: off-the-shelf VLMs beat video embeddings
entries.summary: Research showing that pre-trained vision-language models outperform specialized video embeddings for visual search tasks, giving developers a simpler approach to video understanding without custom training.

entries.title: ExtractBench, an open-source schema extraction benchmark
entries.summary: An open benchmark for evaluating structured data extraction from unstructured text, helping developers benchmark and improve their LLM-based extraction pipelines.

entries.title: Webstractor – Pay-as-You-Go Web Data API for AI Agents
entries.summary: A utility API that provides clean web scraping for AI agents on a consumption-based model, removing infrastructure overhead for developers building data-dependent AI systems.

entries.title: Pickle – token efficient AI agent browser with policy-gated actions
entries.summary: A browser automation tool designed for AI agents that minimizes token usage through intelligent action gating, reducing costs for agents that need to interact with web interfaces.

entries.title: HeyDeacon, AI customer support agent for SaaS founders
entries.summary: A pre-built AI customer support agent template for SaaS platforms, letting developers deploy sophisticated support automation without building agents from scratch.
